evals.prompt: I have a meeting recording at ~/recordings/standup.mp3. I need to transcribe it with speaker labels and get a summary. Use Python and AssemblyAI.
evals.expected_output: A Python script using the AssemblyAI SDK with speaker_labels enabled, a summary produced via Speech Understanding summarization or the LLM Gateway (NOT the deprecated top-level summarization param or LeMUR), and transcript status error-checking.

assertions.text: Uses speaker_labels=True
Produces the summary via Speech Understanding (speech_understanding.request.summarization) or the LLM Gateway — not the deprecated top-level summarization/auto_chapters params and not LeMUR
Checks transcript.status for errors
Uses SDK (not raw API)

evals.prompt: I'm building a voice agent for a dental office using LiveKit and AssemblyAI. Patients will be calling to schedule appointments and I need it to accurately capture names, procedure types, and dates. Can you set up the STT pipeline?
evals.expected_output: A LiveKit STT setup using universal-3-5-pro with correctly tuned endpointing/VAD parameters and domain keyterms, avoiding deprecated parameters and removed models.

assertions.text: Uses universal-3-5-pro (not u3-rt-pro, which was removed July 2026, or older streaming models)
Sets max_turn_silence explicitly (not relying on LiveKit plugin default of 100ms)
Sets endpointing min_delay to 0 (via TurnHandlingOptions) to avoid the additive 500ms delay
Synchronizes VAD thresholds (both ~0.3)
Includes keyterms_prompt with dental vocabulary
Uses STT-based turn detection (turn_detection='stt')
Does not use deprecated word_boost parameter

evals.prompt: I need to transcribe customer support calls, redact PII (names, phone numbers, SSNs), and then use Claude through AssemblyAI's API to extract action items and sentiment from each call. Show me how in TypeScript.
evals.expected_output: A TypeScript implementation using PII redaction policies and AssemblyAI's LLM Gateway (not LeMUR) with a correct Claude model ID and message-based input.

assertions.text: Auth uses raw API key (no Bearer prefix)
Enables PII redaction with person_name, phone_number, us_social_security_number policies
Uses LLM Gateway (llm-gateway.assemblyai.com), NOT LeMUR
Uses a current Claude model ID without provider prefix (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, claude-sonnet-4-6, or claude-sonnet-5 — not anthropic/claude-... and not removed Claude 4.0 IDs)
Passes transcript text in messages, not transcript_ids
If structured outputs (json_schema) are used, the chosen model supports them (Claude 4.5+/OpenAI/Gemini — not Claude 3.x and not claude-sonnet-5)

evals.prompt: Users of my app record short voice memos (usually 30-60 seconds) and I want the transcript back immediately in the same request when the upload hits my Python backend - no polling or job IDs. We're on AssemblyAI. Some memos mention our product names like 'FlowSync Pro' and 'TaskBridge'.
evals.expected_output: A Python implementation using the Sync STT API (SyncTranscriber or POST sync.assemblyai.com/v1/transcribe with X-AAI-Model universal-3-5-pro), keyterms for the product names, and awareness of the 120s limit with async fallback for longer audio.

assertions.text: Uses the Sync STT API (SyncTranscriber or sync.assemblyai.com), not the async transcript API with polling
Uses universal-3-5-pro as the model
Biases product names via keyterms_prompt (not word_boost)
Mentions the 120s (or 40MB) sync limit and/or falls back to the async API for longer recordings
Does not pass unsupported async-only params (e.g. speaker_labels, redact_pii) in the sync config
